decision: SHELVE the standalone treatment-durability reinterpretation; no new publication-worthy clinical finding
validity: Actual all-11 source projection and surgery footnote are reproducible. Three surgery conversions and the eight unlabelled terminal states are preserved. Source-explicit common treatment origin and terminal failure/censor mapping required by the analysis freeze are not established, so all survival/cumulative-event estimates and bounds remain null.
value: Informative complete-surgery censoring is a legitimate limitation when interpreting this selected historical series as an external control. The source already reports those surgeries and subsequent recurrence; R7 already retained the censoring policy and existing endpoint work already addresses indolence and benchmark comparability. This gate does not show bias magnitude, direction, causal activity or a new clinically consequential durability pattern. Missingness alone is not a paper.
specific_primary_claim: PMC3879193 authors suggest the series may serve as external controls for future new-agent studies. The unproven counterfactual surgery-censoring assumption cannot be converted into a demonstrated false clinical claim.
alternative_retained: Complete surgery is a separate and potentially beneficial treatment-strategy event. Do not count surgery as progression or failure. It can change the estimand; nonrandom selection, line, baseline progression and assessment schedules also limit external-control exchangeability.
numerical_results: No CIF, KM, six-month bound, bootstrap, drug comparison or causal estimate was run. Source literal PFS intervals were opened only after ANALYSIS-FROZEN. All11 rows and all3 source-linked postoperative conditions retained.
prior_exposure: Historical R7 individual evaluation reused; current gate read permitted published aggregates and opened exact individual PFS cells only after new freeze. No full-team or full-outcome blinding claim.
coverage: All25 explicitly reused source records plus T-DXd are retained with their native/generic conditions, unfavorable histories and donor overlap. Seven current broader-trial main schemas checked and hashed; wider535-citation source-body coverage and specific individual figures/full tables remain pending. Not an exhaustive systemic-therapy or all-EMC statement.
reopening: Actual public definition or case-linked release authenticating treatment origin and every PFS failure/censor/intercurrent event, including postoperative events
A concrete clinically consequential distinction beyond authors reported surgery courses and known historical endpoint problems
Full relevant public EMC conditions and donor overlap evaluated, with independent value and omission challenge before promotion
pending_independent_review: Radiotherapy has prospective analysis freeze, exact original/input/results hashes; final review will be referenced additively without changing this science.
